title: GitLab code host delivers a GitHub-tracked item through gated merge requests

rubric.text: Routes merge-request operations through the GitLab binding and linking and closure through the GitHub tracker; never uses gh for the code host or closing keywords.

Merges only when GitLab reports the request mergeable at the expected head with passing pipeline and resolved discussions; treats failed pipelines, other merge statuses and merge-train membership as pending, never merged.

Keeps the non-closing source link and verifies an empty effective closing set using independent completeness evidence and closes the GitHub issue only after verified merge readback, reporting ticket completion separately.
